text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting President of French senate says: "Morocco is one of our great friends".
- Moroccan and Tunisian prime ministers meet over ways to reinforce bilateral cooperation.
- Uncertainty over the European Union's decision regarding Morocco's proposal to extend period for recovery of fish stocks to four months.
- Morocco and Portugal sign accords to extend cooperation in fishing industries.
- Moroccan General Confederation of Businesses studies new legislation shaping limited companies.
